rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy's revenue for the 2025 financial year, its most recently closed year, was EUR 20,300,000, comfortably above the turnover threshold stated in this section.
Visakoivu Oy employs 48 professionals in its electrical (sahko) discipline, well above the minimum required in this section.

Within the last five years, Visakoivu Oy has delivered several comparable maintenance and installation projects, including REF05 (Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, a school-facilities HVAC maintenance framework), REF08 (Tuomisto Oy, an annual facilities maintenance contract at an industrial property), REF09 (Nareikko Teollisuus Oy, building automation and electrical works for a factory expansion), and REF10 (Kelohonka Logistiikka Oy, HVAC outsourcing across three logistics facilities), comfortably exceeding the number of comparable references required in this section.
Visakoivu Oy holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate, and will ensure it remains current at the time the quotation is submitted.
Visakoivu Oy holds a current F-gas regulation qualification covering refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment, applicable to the cooling and air-handling plant within scope at this facility.

Visakoivu Oy's revenue for the 2025 financial year was EUR 20,300,000. Visakoivu Oy notes that this section restates the turnover requirement at a higher threshold than Section 2.1; the same figure satisfies both as stated.

Waste from maintenance and repair work is segregated and removed by licensed waste contractors, emissions from refrigerant handling are controlled under Visakoivu Oy's F-gas qualification and recorded per unit worked on, and noisy works are scheduled and, where practicable, screened to limit disruption to production and office areas.

Visakoivu Oy proposes scheduled HVAC maintenance visits at intervals set by system type and criticality, with a written service report issued after each visit covering condition observations, work performed, and any follow-up actions required.

Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual visual inspection of roofing, cladding, and building fabric, with findings reported alongside the maintenance reporting described in Section 3.8, and any structural concerns referred to a qualified building surveyor.

Completed maintenance and repair work is checked against a written completion checklist specific to the system worked on, signed off by a supervisor independent of the technician who performed the work, under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 7310 quality management system.
Visakoivu Oy offers a warranty period of 24 months on equipment and materials it installs under this contract, in line with its standard terms.

Personnel attend the shift supervisor on arrival, sign in and out at each visit, and wear the identification and personal protective equipment required for the production areas they enter, in accordance with the Buyer's site rules.

Visakoivu Oy will run a rolling programme of statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations across the facility, sequenced so that no installation exceeds its required inspection interval, under its electrical contracting rights.
Scheduled maintenance visits are planned by system and criticality, with the proposed content and frequency for each system category set out in the maintenance schedule accompanying this quotation.

On contract start, Visakoivu Oy will verify the existing asset register and technical documentation against a walk-through of the production hall, machine shop, and office wing, record any discrepancies in writing, and maintain the register as a living document for the contract duration.

Following any equipment replacement, Visakoivu Oy runs a commissioning checklist covering functional testing, safety interlocks, and control-system integration, and issues a signed commissioning record to the Buyer before the equipment is returned to service.

Installation works are sequenced with the shift supervisor to avoid active production lines, with temporary containment and isolation plans agreed in advance for the affected system, and disruptive work scheduled outside core production hours wherever practicable.

If a reported fault is not resolved within the agreed response time, the case is escalated to Visakoivu Oy's on-call supervisor, and, if still unresolved after a further two hours, to the service manager responsible for the contract, with the Buyer's facilities contact notified at each step.

Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on the schedule set by the applicable standards and equipment manufacturers' requirements, with test and maintenance records filed and made available to the Buyer on request.

Each system area is assigned a named primary and backup technician, and Visakoivu Oy maintains up-to-date handover documentation so that a departing or reassigned team member can be replaced without a gap in service.

Condition-monitoring readings taken during scheduled visits (vibration, temperature, and electrical load readings where applicable) are logged against each asset and reported to the Buyer's facilities contact as part of the visit report described in Section 3.8, with any adverse trend flagged separately.
Typical lead time for common HVAC, electrical, and building-automation spare parts is 3-5 working days from Visakoivu Oy's own stock or supplier network.

Visakoivu Oy does not propose a retention percentage on invoiced amounts; invoiced work is payable in full on the agreed payment terms, subject to normal defect-liability obligations under its standard terms.
Visakoivu Oy confirms its acceptance of the payment terms set out in this request and its annexes.

Visakoivu Oy proposes monthly invoicing and can invoice electronically in the Finnish national e-invoicing format (Finvoice), or another format the Buyer's financial systems require, to be confirmed during contract finalisation.
Where subcontractors are used, Visakoivu Oy will disclose the subcontracted scope and its corresponding cost component to the Buyer on request, distinguishing it from Visakoivu Oy's own direct cost.

Visakoivu Oy's pricing structure distinguishes a fixed annual price for scheduled maintenance visits, unit prices for parts and materials drawn down against actual use, and a time-based hourly rate for call-out work outside scheduled visits, set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this quotation.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a tiered discount on unit-priced parts and materials as annual order volume increases, applied retrospectively each contract year once the relevant volume tier is confirmed, with exact tier thresholds set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this quotation.

Visakoivu Oy's headline price is supported by a cost breakdown separating labour, parts and materials, subcontracted work where applicable, and overhead, set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this quotation.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and enclose the subcontractor list (Liite 3), naming any subcontractors it intends to use for this contract.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract, including their trade qualifications and relevant project experience.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and enclose the Buyer's standard tender form (Liite 1).
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a description of its NMSB 7310 quality management system with its quotation, covering the elements relevant to this contract's scope.
Visakoivu Oy's quotation document does not exceed 20 pages, excluding attachments.
Visakoivu Oy quotes its prices in EUR per square metre per year, as required, and not in EUR per month.
All prices in Visakoivu Oy's quotation are quoted excluding VAT, in euro.
Visakoivu Oy notes that the closing date and time for quotations is 13 October 2026 at 14:00 Finnish time (EET/EEST as applicable), as stated in Section 7, and will submit before that deadline.
Visakoivu Oy will submit its quotation as a single PDF file, without password protection.

Visakoivu Oy notes that the closing time is the time its quotation is recorded as received in the Buyer's mailbox in Finnish time, not the time it is sent, and will submit with sufficient margin so that receipt is recorded before 14:00:00.

The office wing's passenger lift is maintained and inspected in compliance with applicable Finnish lift regulations by an accredited inspection body, with inspection certificates and maintenance records filed in the property's technical documentation and made available to the Buyer on request.

Maintenance activity, findings, and outstanding items are reported to the Buyer's facilities contact after each visit, in a written report covering work performed, condition observations, and any items requiring follow-up or Buyer decision.

Personnel working in the production areas hold trade qualifications appropriate to their discipline, complete the site induction covering the facility's specific hazards before their first visit, and observe the Buyer's personal protective equipment and access requirements at all times.

Where a trade is subcontracted, the subcontractor is selected from Visakoivu Oy's approved supplier list, is qualified to the same standard required of Visakoivu Oy's own staff, and is supervised on site by a Visakoivu Oy foreman who signs off the completed work.

Visakoivu Oy's preventive maintenance plan covers HVAC, electrical, building automation, and life-safety systems across the production hall, machine shop, and office wing, with inspection intervals set by system criticality and manufacturer recommendation.

Visakoivu Oy proposes differentiated response times by fault severity and maintains on-call cover outside normal working hours through its own rostered technicians, backed by the escalation path described in Section 3.12.

For corrective, non-emergency maintenance requests, Visakoivu Oy proposes a response time set separately from, and longer than, the fault-response times described in A.6, with the request logged and scheduled into the next practicable maintenance window.

Visakoivu Oy's personnel will give prior notice to the shift supervisor before entering production areas, and will schedule maintenance work affecting production lines outside core production hours wherever practicable, as required by this section.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a bonus-malus scheme under which a bonus of a small percentage of the affected period's invoiced maintenance fee applies for sustained over-performance against agreed service levels, and an equivalent malus applies for sustained under-performance, calculated quarterly and confirmed in writing to the Buyer; exact percentages are set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this quotation.
Visakoivu Oy does not request any advance payment for this contract; invoicing follows the frequency and terms described in Section 4.3.
Visakoivu Oy's quoted prices remain valid for the 90-day period stated, from the closing date given in Section 7 of the main request.
Visakoivu Oy's quotation, including the commercial schedules completed in this annex, uses a minimum font size of 11 pt throughout.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a description of its NMSB 74210 environmental management system with its quotation.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a trade register extract issued no earlier than three months before the closing date.
The quotation will be signed by a registered signatory of Visakoivu Oy; should a different person sign on Visakoivu Oy's behalf, a power of attorney for that person will be enclosed.

Visakoivu Oy will complete and enclose the reference form (Liite 2), referenced in the draft agreement's enclosures clause though not separately listed in Section 5, together with the tender form (Liite 1) and, where applicable, the subcontractor list (Liite 3).
Visakoivu Oy will ensure personnel assigned to this contract meet the qualification and access requirements described in Liite A and observe the Buyer's site rules at all times.
Visakoivu Oy's accepted commercial terms limit its liability to the limits of its liability insurance cover of EUR 2,000,000, save for liability that cannot be limited by law.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation in response to Konepaja Ryhtila Oy's request for technical maintenance services covering the Ryhtila production and office facility (Reference KR-RFQ-2026-11).
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy, founded in 1994 and based in Jyvaskyla, is a technical and property services company employing approximately 180 people across HVAC, electrical, building automation, and facilities management disciplines in Central Finland and the surrounding region.
